title: Progress bar in Task Manager goes out of bounds and also creates a line within itself at the beginning of the process.
line: The task progress bar no longer sticks out past the task's edge or shows a darker line inside it at the start of a download.
explanation: The task's progress bar is a 9-piece SVG frame whose width was the task width times the progress, with no lower bound. Below the width of its own left and right borders the pieces overlapped: at about 5-10% the bar gained a faint column one pixel outside its normal edge and a darker band where the semi-transparent pieces stacked, and at 0-2% it already showed a 3 px bar. The change puts the frame inside a clipping item of the progress width and keeps the frame itself at least as wide as its borders, so the pieces never overlap and only the progress part is visible.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: don't let the progress frame pieces overlap

At low progress the progress frame got narrower than its borders, so its
pieces overlapped into a darker band and a column past the bar's edge.
Keep the frame at least as wide as its borders and clip it to progress.

BUG: 526828

patches.diff:
From ab40f6dbb823a9d83f189ecb8313ddb0472d13c5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:25:25 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: don't let the progress frame pieces
 overlap

At low progress the progress frame got narrower than its borders, so its
pieces overlapped into a darker band and a column past the bar's edge.
Keep the frame at least as wide as its borders and clip it to progress.

BUG: 526828
---
 .../taskmanager/qml/TaskProgressOverlay.qml   | 21 ++++++++++++-------
 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskProgressOverlay.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskProgressOverlay.qml
index 50682907f3..f8cfd39f4a 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskProgressOverlay.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskProgressOverlay.qml
@@ -28,18 +28,25 @@ T.ProgressBar {
     value: task.smartLauncherItem.progress
 
     contentItem: Item {
-        clip: true
-
-        KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
-            id: progressFrame
-
+        Item {
             LayoutMirroring.enabled: Application.layoutDirection === Qt.RightToLeft
+            LayoutMirroring.childrenInherit: true
             anchors.left: parent.left
             width: parent.width * control.position
             height: parent.height
+            clip: true
+
+            KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+                id: progressFrame
+
+                anchors.left: parent.left
+                // Not narrower than its borders, or the frame pieces overlap; the parent clips it to the progress
+                width: Math.max(parent.width, fixedMargins.left + fixedMargins.right)
+                height: parent.height
 
-            imagePath: "widgets/tasks"
-            prefix: TaskManagerApplet.TaskTools.taskPrefix("progress", Plasmoid.location).concat(TaskManagerApplet.TaskTools.taskPrefix("hover", Plasmoid.location))
+                imagePath: "widgets/tasks"
+                prefix: TaskManagerApplet.TaskTools.taskPrefix("progress", Plasmoid.location).concat(TaskManagerApplet.TaskTools.taskPrefix("hover", Plasmoid.location))
+            }
         }
     }
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master, left edge of the Konsole task at 8x, progress 0, 0.02, 0.05, 0.08, 0.1, 0.15, 0.5: a 3 px bar at 0/0.02, a pale column outside the edge at 0.05/0.08 and a darker band at 0.08/0.1
With the fix, same values: nothing at 0/0.02, then a uniform bar starting at the normal edge that grows 2, 3, 4 px; 0.15 and 0.5 unchanged
With the fix in right-to-left layout (plasmashell -reverse), right edge of the task at 0, 0.05, 0.08, 0.1, 0.5: bar grows cleanly from the right
